exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, cesarean section with medical indications, cesarean section due to social factors)
Cesarean section due to social factors
finding: Cesarean section due to social factors was associated with increased risk of inattention, hyperactivity/impulsivity, social problems, and executive dysfunction in children aged 7-15 years.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, even without medical indications, was associated with increased risk of psychological and behavioral problems in children.
